scope: Phase 0 Cloud Billing + Tax local foundation only
claim: Implemented metadata-only tenant class, paid billing component, demo-trial cap, metering/invoice/tax/audit evidence guardrails for Cloud Billing + Tax and truth-downed manifests/catalog records to code-backed local-foundation claims.

actual_state_before_change: oya-cloud-billing-domain already had billing account, cloud billing event, platform meter handoff, invoice arithmetic, regional tax pack, and tax registration invariants.
oya-metering-domain already had in-memory idempotent meter events and unit invariants.
oya-cloud-billing-tax-app already validated invoice API request metadata and regional-pack-to-tax-invoice-format labels.

microservices/cloud-billing and microservices/cloud-billing-tax manifests overclaimed layers, GA planning IPs, measured SLOs, DR, sharding, mesh, IaC, OSS runtimes, and audit-chain runtime emission without code-backed local evidence.
Catalog records for missing billing/adapter/application and platform-metering app/kernel crates implied runtime surfaces that do not exist in this checkout.
source_inspection.authoritative_next_slice_before_change: tasks/plan.md identified Cloud Billing + Tax as the next Phase 0 slice after Cloud Compute; Cloud IaC was already closed for its local foundation surface.

official_sources_used.name: FinOps FOCUS Specification
official_sources_used.relevance: FOCUS defines uniform cost and usage billing datasets, invoice reconciliation, allocation, recency, and completeness concerns; this slice records FOCUS export as a future runtime non-claim.

official_sources_used.name: Stripe Idempotent Requests API reference
official_sources_used.relevance: Billing mutation retries should use non-sensitive idempotency keys and compare request parameters; this slice keeps idempotent metering local and rejects secret-like refs.

official_sources_used.name: Stripe Billing Meter Event API reference
official_sources_used.relevance: Meter events are a common billing primitive; this slice keeps meter event handling metadata-only and does not claim live billing ingest.

official_sources_used.name: European Commission VAT invoicing rules
official_sources_used.relevance: VAT invoicing can require electronic invoice formats and national rules; this slice validates tax invoice format labels only and does not claim statutory tax calculation/filing.

official_sources_used.name: AWS Cost and Usage Reports line item details
official_sources_used.relevance: Cloud billing records need usage amount, rate, cost, account, tax type, and time window dimensions; this slice locks local evidence metadata but does not implement provider CUR export.

official_sources_used.name: Google Cloud Billing export to BigQuery setup
official_sources_used.relevance: Provider billing exports require scoped billing/data permissions and dataset placement; this slice explicitly avoids claiming runtime billing exports.

official_sources_used.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Cost Reports
official_sources_used.relevance: OCI cost reports include resource-level usage/cost and FOCUS cost reports; this slice records provider cost report integrations as future non-claims.

official_sources_used.name: ZATCA E-Invoicing
official_sources_used.relevance: E-invoicing often includes jurisdiction-specific structured invoice and clearance requirements; this slice maps tax invoice labels but does not implement government clearance.

behavior_added: TenantClass enum with demo_trial and paid labels.
BillingComponent enum with revenue_share, per_seat, and per_usage labels.
CloudBillingTenantGuardrail metadata object validates tenant id, region, billing account id, rate card ref, invoice id, billing period, regional pack and tax invoice format alignment.
Paid tenants require at least one unique paid billing component; demo_trial tenants cannot enable paid components and require demo-trial cap evidence.

Metering, invoice, tax, audit-chain, and demo-trial-cap evidence refs must use billing-owned prefixes, include tenant/region scope, avoid traversal/whitespace/control characters, avoid duplicate metering refs, and reject secret-like markers.
Shared metering domain tenant/id validation rejects uppercase/unsafe reference segments.
